# Setup

Install `dodo` (if needed):

```{r install-dodo, output=FALSE}
renv::install("Louis-Backstrom/dodo@development")
```

```{r dodo-version}
cat("Using dodo version", as.character(packageVersion("dodo")))
```

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(dodo)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(countrycode)
library(rgbif)
library(future)
library(furrr)
library(ggh4x)
library(slider)
library(sf)
```

Get models:

```{r get-models}
models <- c("BA26B1", "BA26B2", "BA26B3", "BA26B4")
```

Set up parallel processing:

```{r setup-parallel}
plan(multisession, workers = floor(availableCores() * 0.75))
# plan(sequential)
```

Set key parameters:

```{r overwrite}
overwrite <- FALSE
```

```{r parameters}
alpha <- 0.05

init_time <- 1861 # First year with GBIF bird data in range
curr_time <- 2026 # Current year

certainty_threshold <- 0.9
```

Set up functions for models:

```{r model-functions}
run_model <- function(model, records, effort, alpha, test_time) {
  out <- switch(model,
    "BA26B1" = BA26B1(
      records = records$cdis, alpha = alpha, init.time = init_time,
      test.time = test_time,
      priors = list(theta_max = c(1, 10), g = 10, lambda = c(1, 1)),
      n.chains = 4, n.iter = 11e4, n.burnin = 1e4, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "BA26B2" = BA26B2(
      records = records$udis, alpha = alpha, init.time = init_time,
      test.time = test_time,
      priors = list(
        theta_max = c(1, 10), g = 10,
        lambda_v = c(1, 1), lambda_i = c(1, 1)
      ),
      n.chains = 4, n.iter = 11e4, n.burnin = 1e4, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "BA26B3" = BA26B3(
      records = records$cdis, effort = as.data.frame(effort),
      alpha = alpha, init.time = init_time, test.time = test_time,
      scale.effort = TRUE, variable.selection = TRUE,
      priors = list(theta_max = c(1, 10), g = 10, rate = 10, inclusion = NULL),
      n.chains = 4, n.iter = 11e4, n.burnin = 1e4, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "BA26B4" = BA26B4(
      records = records$udis, effort = as.data.frame(effort),
      alpha = alpha, init.time = init_time, test.time = test_time,
      scale.effort = TRUE, variable.selection = TRUE,
      priors = list(
        theta_max = c(1, 10), g = 10, rate_v = 10, rate_i = 10,
        inclusion_v = NULL, inclusion_i = NULL
      ),
      n.chains = 4, n.iter = 11e4, n.burnin = 1e4, n.thin = 10
    ),
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model)
  }

  return(out)
}

test_model <- function(model, output, alpha, test_time) {
  out <- switch(model,
    "BA26B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BA26B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BA26B3" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BA26B4" = output$p.extant < alpha,
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model)
  }

  return(out)
}
```

Set up output directory:

```{r directory}
dir.create(file.path("Outputs", "Prigogine's Greenbul"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

# Data

Read in and process records datasheet:

```{r records}
records_raw <- read_xlsx("Data/Prigogine's Greenbul.xlsx",
  sheet = 1, range = "A1:D16"
) %>%
  select(
    year = "Year",
    p_ci_min = "P(CI) Lower",
    p_ci = "P(CI) Est",
    p_ci_max = "P(CI) Upper"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year >= init_time,
    year <= curr_time
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

lost_time <- records_raw %>%
  filter(
    p_ci >= certainty_threshold, # Confirmed records
  ) %>%
  pull(year) %>%
  max()

test_times <- lost_time:curr_time
grid <- expand.grid(test_time = test_times)

records_full <- convert_dodo(records_raw,
  init.time = init_time, test.time = curr_time,
  threshold = certainty_threshold, unique = FALSE,
  aggregate = "max", time = "year", certainty = "p_ci",
  certainty_lower = "p_ci_min", certainty_upper = "p_ci_max"
)
```

Create or read in effort proxy:

```{r effort, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!file.exists("Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul/effort_full.rds") | overwrite) {
  effort_raw <- read_tsv("Data/Prigogine's Greenbul.csv")

  range_sf <- read_sf("Data/Prigogine's Greenbul.gpkg")

  effort_full <- effort_raw %>%
    filter(year %in% init_time:curr_time) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
    mutate(inRange = st_intersects(., range_sf) %>%
      as.logical() %>%
      replace_na(., FALSE)) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(inRange == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      n_species_a = n_distinct(species),
      n_species_s = n_distinct(species[basisOfRecord == "PRESERVED_SPECIMEN"]),
      n_species_o = n_distinct(species[basisOfRecord != "PRESERVED_SPECIMEN"]),
      n_species_b = n_distinct(species[family == "Pycnonotidae"])
    ) %>%
    right_join(tibble(year = init_time:curr_time)) %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    column_to_rownames("year") %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  weights <- dnorm(-10:10, sd = 2)

  effort_full <- effort_full %>%
    mutate(across(
      everything(),
      \(x) slide_dbl(
        x,
        ~ {
          n <- length(.x)
          w <- weights[((length(weights) - n) %/% 2 + 1):
          ((length(weights) - n) %/% 2 + n)]
          weighted.mean(.x, w)
        },
        .before = 10, .after = 10
      )
    ))

  effort_full <- as.data.frame(effort_full)
} else {
  effort_full <- readRDS("Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul/effort_full.rds")
}
```

Save full processed datasets:

```{r save-data}
saveRDS(records_full, "Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul/records_full.rds")
saveRDS(effort_full, "Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul/effort_full.rds")
```

# Run

```{r set-seed}
set.seed(1234)
```

Run models:

```{r run-models}
if (file.exists("Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul/model_times.rds")) {
  model_times <- readRDS("Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul/model_times.rds")
} else {
  model_times <- tibble(
    model = character(), run_time = numeric(),
    end_time = POSIXct()
  )
}

for (model in models) {
  model_start <- Sys.time()
  model_ran <- FALSE

  model_file <- file.path("Outputs", "Prigogine's Greenbul", paste0(model, ".rds"))

  valid_file <- FALSE
  if (file.exists(model_file)) {
    check <- readRDS(model_file)
    if (!is.null(check$results) && nrow(check$results) == nrow(grid)) {
      valid_file <- TRUE
    }
    rm(check)
  }

  if (!valid_file || overwrite == TRUE) {
    model_ran <- TRUE

    results <- future_map(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(idx) {
      test_time <- grid$test_time[idx]

      records <- convert_dodo(records_raw,
        init.time = init_time,
        test.time = test_time, threshold = certainty_threshold, unique = FALSE,
        aggregate = "max", time = "year", certainty = "p_ci",
        certainty_lower = "p_ci_min", certainty_upper = "p_ci_max"
      )

      if (is.data.frame(effort_full)) {
        effort <- effort_full[1:(test_time - init_time + 1), , drop = FALSE]
      } else if (is.vector(effort_full)) {
        effort <- effort_full[1:(test_time - init_time + 1)]
      } else {
        stop("invalid effort format")
      }

      iteration_start <- Sys.time()

      warning_msg <- character()
      error_msg <- NA_character_

      output <- tryCatch(
        withCallingHandlers(
          run_model(
            model = model, records = records,
            effort = effort, alpha = alpha, test_time = test_time
          ),
          warning = function(w) {
            warning_msg <<- c(warning_msg, conditionMessage(w))
            invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
          }
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          error_msg <<- conditionMessage(e)
          NULL
        }
      )

      i_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), iteration_start, units = "secs") %>%
        as.numeric()

      result <- if (is.null(output)) {
        tibble(
          model = model, test_time = test_time,
          last_time = max(records$ccon), isextinct = NA, output = NA,
          warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = TRUE,
          warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
            paste(unique(warning_msg), collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
          error_msg = if (length(error_msg) > 0) {
            paste(unique(error_msg), collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
        )
      } else {
        tibble(
          model = model, test_time = test_time,
          last_time = max(records$ccon), isextinct = test_model(
            model, output, alpha, test_time
          ), output = list(output),
          warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = FALSE,
          warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
            paste(unique(warning_msg), collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
          error_msg = NA_character_, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
        )
      }

      rm(output)
      gc()

      return(result)
    }, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

    all_results <- bind_rows(results)

    saveRDS(list(model = model, results = all_results), model_file)
  }

  if (model_ran == TRUE) {
    m_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), model_start, units = "secs"))

    model_times <- model_times %>%
      filter(model != !!model) %>%
      bind_rows(tibble(
        model = model, run_time = m_time,
        end_time = Sys.time()
      ))
  }

  gc()
}

saveRDS(model_times, "Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul/model_times.rds")
```

# Finish

Results:

```{r results}
model_files <- list.files(
  "Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul",
  pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE
)
model_files <- model_files[!grepl("model_times\\.rds$", model_files)]
model_files <- model_files[!grepl("records_full\\.rds$", model_files)]
model_files <- model_files[!grepl("effort_full\\.rds$", model_files)]

all_results <- map_dfr(model_files, function(model_file) {
  results_file <- readRDS(model_file)

  if (!is.null(results_file$results)) {
    results_file$results
  } else {
    warning("No results in ", basename(model_file))
    NULL
  }
})

model_times <- readRDS("Outputs/Prigogine's Greenbul/model_times.rds")
total_time <- sum(model_times$run_time) / 60
cat(sprintf("Total model execution time: %.2f minutes\n", total_time))
```

# Runtime

```{r runtime}
#| fig-dpi: 300
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(model_times) +
  geom_col(
    aes(x = factor(model, levels = models), y = run_time / 60)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Total Runtime (min)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, family = "mono", face = "bold"
  ))
```

# Summary

```{r summary}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 2
all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

excluded <- all_results %>%
  left_join(tibble(model = models), ., by = "model") %>%
  filter(is.na(isextinct)) %>%
  select(model) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

inc_results <- all_results %>%
  filter_out(model %in% excluded$model) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

cat("Excluded (NA outputs):", as.character(excluded$model))

results_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = inc_results,
    aes(x = test_time, y = as.integer(isextinct))
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = inc_results,
    aes(x = test_time, y = as.integer(isextinct)), linewidth = 1
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Test Time",
    y = "Extinct (1) / Extant (0)"
  )

results_plot +
  facet_wrap2(~model,
    drop = FALSE, ncol = 4, nrow = 1,
    axes = "all", remove_labels = "all"
  )
```

```{r summary-models}
curr_extinct <- inc_results %>%
  filter(test_time == max(test_time))

cat("Extinction inference in final year:")
curr_extinct %>%
  group_by(isextinct) %>%
  tally()

curr_estimate <- curr_extinct %>%
  filter(model %in% models, !is.na(isextinct)) %>%
  mutate(estimate = unlist(purrr::map(output, "estimate"))) %>%
  select(model, estimate)

cat("Estimated extinction times:")
curr_estimate

curr_interval <- curr_extinct %>%
  filter(model %in% models, !is.na(isextinct)) %>%
  mutate(interval = purrr::map(output, ~ .x$cred.int %||% .x$conf.int)) %>%
  unnest_wider(interval, names_sep = "_") %>%
  select(model, interval = interval_2)

cat("Estimated upper interval bounds:")
curr_interval
```

# Errors, Warnings, etc.

```{r issues}
all_results %>%
  filter(is.na(warning_msg) == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(model, warning_msg) %>%
  tally() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

all_results %>%
  filter(is.na(error_msg) == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(model, error_msg) %>%
  tally() %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
